name: Complete active OpenSpec changes by reducing active change count

description: Baseline: 34 active OpenSpec changes remain before sel4-asid-pools remediation.

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline active change count before reducing it by completing and archiving changes.

description: Archive sel4-asid-pools: land verified sel4_asid model, sync sel4-asid spec/requirements, and move change into archive to cut active change count from 34 to 33.

asi.hypothesis: Finishing and archiving the smallest ready seL4 change should reduce active change count by one without reopening coverage or verification drift.
asi.validation: autoresearch.checks.sh passed: cargo test, clippy, verus, check-ensures, tracey uncovered, tracey untested
asi.next_action_hint: Scan remaining active changes for another nearly-landed small domain, preferably one with code mostly done and only sync/archive drift left.

description: Archive sel4-cap-rights: land verified rights-mask algebra, sync sel4-cap-rights requirements/spec text, and move change into archive to cut active change count from 33 to 32.

asi.hypothesis: A small rights-bitmask module modeled after existing zircon rights primitives can close sel4-cap-rights quickly and safely.
asi.validation: Targeted cargo test + module verus passed, then autoresearch.checks.sh passed with full cargo/clippy/verus/check-ensures/tracey, and archive evidence captured verify.sh plus repo-sync logs.
asi.next_action_hint: Inspect sel4-cspace-lookup first for another small single-domain archive candidate.

description: Archive sel4-cspace-lookup: land verified guarded CSpace traversal, sync sel4-cspace requirements/spec text, and move change into archive to cut active change count from 32 to 31.

asi.hypothesis: A small explicit-segment CSpace model should close lookup faster than a raw bitfield model while still satisfying guarded traversal and exact slot-resolution requirements.
asi.validation: Targeted cargo test + module verus passed, repo-level cargo/clippy/verus/check-ensures/verify/tracey evidence captured, and autoresearch.checks.sh passed on the archived tree.
asi.key_design_choice: Model path as explicit guard segments plus one slot-selection segment per level; recursive lookup decreases on remaining path length, so no separate acyclicity invariant is needed.
asi.pitfall: Verus old(...) cannot express post-state equality for read-only &T params; use immutable APIs plus failure-case tests/proofs instead of old(shared_ref) ensures.
asi.next_action_hint: Inspect sel4-cap-derivation next; it stays in seL4 capability space and may reuse sel4-cap-rights plus tree-style proof patterns.

description: Archive sel4-cap-derivation: land verified sel4_cdt model, sync sel4-cdt requirements/spec text, capture validation evidence, and move the change into archive to cut active change count from 31 to 30; autoresearch checks failed on a cargo doctest crate-version mismatch in web_of_trust_principal/blake3 rather than sel4_cdt logic.

asi.hypothesis: sel4-cap-derivation was small and adjacent to earlier seL4 capability work, so landing src/sel4_cdt.rs plus synced docs/specs and archiving the change should reduce active change count by one without reopening verification drift.
asi.rollback_reason: autoresearch.checks.sh failed during cargo test doctests with error E0460: found possibly newer version of crate arrayref which blake3 depends on in src/web_of_trust_principal.rs; benchmark metric improved but repo-wide validation was not green in the autoresearch harness.
asi.next_action_hint: Restore the archived sel4-cap-derivation work from the saved tarball/patch, reproduce the doctest mismatch outside autoresearch, fix or stabilize the cargo doctest dependency state, then rerun ./autoresearch.sh.
asi.targeted_validation: ./scripts/verus.sh src/sel4_cdt.rs passed; targeted cargo test sel4_cdt passed; pueue full validation capture also passed before autoresearch harness hit the doctest mismatch.
asi.failure_detail: run_experiment reported benchmark pass with active_changes=30, but checks failed in cargo doctest stage with blake3/arrayref version skew.

description: Checks passed after cleaning the stale blake3 artifact, but this rerun still measured active_changes=31 because the active sel4-cap-derivation directory was still present alongside the archive copy after restore; no true archive reduction yet.

asi.hypothesis: Re-running after `cargo clean -p blake3` would confirm the sel4-cap-derivation archive work and turn the earlier doctest-only failure into a green keep.
asi.rollback_reason: The working tree still contained `openspec/changes/sel4-cap-derivation`, so the metric stayed at 31 instead of the intended 30. Keeping this run would commit a duplicate active+archived change rather than a real reduction.
asi.next_action_hint: Restore the saved sel4-cap-derivation work from /tmp/sel4-cap-derivation-work.tgz, delete the still-active `openspec/changes/sel4-cap-derivation` directory, clean blake3 again if needed, then rerun ./autoresearch.sh.
asi.stabilization: `cargo clean -p blake3` fixed the doctest E0460 mismatch and made autoresearch.checks.sh pass on this rerun.

description: Archive sel4-cap-derivation again reached active_changes=30, but autoresearch.checks.sh still failed on the same cargo doctest E0460 blake3/arrayref skew; cleaning blake3 outside the harness was not sufficient.

asi.hypothesis: With the active sel4-cap-derivation directory removed, the archive work should benchmark at active_changes=30; if the doctest skew was only a stale local artifact, a pre-run `cargo clean -p blake3` would let checks pass.
asi.rollback_reason: Checks still failed in cargo doctest with `error[E0460]: found possibly newer version of crate arrayref which blake3 depends on` even after a manual `cargo clean -p blake3` before run_experiment, so the harness itself needs a deterministic cleanup step.
asi.next_action_hint: Restore the saved worktree, add a `cargo clean -p blake3` stabilization step to autoresearch.checks.sh before cargo test, then rerun ./autoresearch.sh to verify the 30-active-change state under the same harness that log_experiment uses.
asi.failure_detail: Manual `cargo test --quiet` passed immediately after `cargo clean -p blake3`, but the same doctest mismatch recurred inside autoresearch.checks.sh during run_experiment.

description: Archive sel4-cap-derivation: land verified sel4_cdt model, sync sel4-cdt requirements/spec text, capture targeted and full validation evidence, move the change under openspec/changes/archive/2026-04-15-sel4-cap-derivation/, and stabilize autoresearch.checks.sh with `cargo clean -p blake3` so the repo-wide doctest skew no longer blocks a real archive reduction.

asi.hypothesis: sel4-cap-derivation was small, adjacent to earlier seL4 capability work, and ready to finish; archiving it plus making the autoresearch checks robust to the known blake3 doctest skew should reduce active change count by one under the real harness.
